We build a time-step diﬀerence equation [8] model in years to predict propagation. Based on

Like other wasps, Asian giant hornets are an annual species, and the time points when
queens produce male peak females are concentrated in September to November. Therefore,
the life of the species has a strong periodicity, which belongs to rigid seasonal behaviour. This
